scope: GQ-009 claim-layer control surface; GQ-010 fame versus dependence

questions.text: How should the Great Library make questions visible, composable, continuously updated, and connected to evidence and approved action, without becoming the corpus warehouse or execution runtime?
Does popularity identify the software the world actually depends on, or does it systematically mismeasure it?
Which available model should own each recurring work shape after quality, reliability, tool use, latency, quota, and cost are evaluated together?
questions.note: Registered God Question, not minted here. Registry marks it 'answered' with no falsifiers; this claim proposes a cost-dimension correction.
